Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If your opponent has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon. If they have 7 or more, they trash 1 card in their hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has 6 or fewer cards in their hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
